name: ctb_small
description: CTB small functions: tick speed and opening bound by Agility, Haste/Slow, the recovery for a rank, the tie-break key, the ready-list sort, the CTB amount, the action rank and the revive counter.

harness.note: the real machine code of the functions, only the RNG function replaced by a script; rngDraws is what the game asked for

notes: actionRank: the command lookup (0x78ce50) is replaced by a table of rank bytes; ranks maps command id to the rank byte or null (no record).
revive: the animation helpers are replaced by no-ops; only the counter, HP floor, Death bit and Auto-Life flag are recorded.
